Class Pawn

java.lang.Object
pieces.Piece
pieces.Pawn
public class Pawn extends Piece
Represents a Pawn chess piece ("wp" for White, "bp" for Black). Pawns move forward one square (or two squares from their initial rank) into empty squares, and capture diagonally forward one square.

    • possibleMoves

      public List<Position> possibleMoves(Board board)
      Calculates all valid forward and diagonal-capture moves for this Pawn. White pawns move up the grid (row - 1); Black pawns move down the grid (row + 1).
      Specified by:
      possibleMoves in class Piece
      Parameters:
      board - the current chessboard state
      Returns:
      a List of valid destination Position coordinates
